year, engines, seats, and speed are landed as DECIMAL(38,9) but every sample and distinct_value observed is a whole number (e.g. engines distinct_values 1.0-4.0, seats min 2.0 max 450.0), so all four are cast to INTEGER.

purpose: This table provides one cleaned record per aircraft tail number describing its registered manufacturer, model, type, engine configuration, seating capacity, manufacture year, and cruise speed where known, feeding downstream flight-delay and fleet-analysis models that join on tail number.
usage: Join to flight fact tables on tailnum; treat year and speed as optionally null and handle missing values explicitly rather than assuming zero or a default, since speed is populated for fewer than 1% of aircraft.
limitations: speed is populated for only 23 of 3322 aircraft (null_rate 0.993076) and should not be used for broad fleet-speed analysis; year is missing for 70 aircraft (null_rate 0.021072); no duplicate rows were found (duplicate_row_rate 0.0) so no dedupe logic was applied.
